subject: Cohort Spotlight: Collaborative Labs pilot — logistics and assets
messages:
From: Lucia Gomez <lucia@devcraft.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cohort Spotlight: Collaborative Labs pilot — logistics and assets

Hi Mina / team,

Great to meet at Summit last month — thanks again for taking the time. DevCraft would love to run a small pilot joint event with Redwood called the "Cohort Spotlight: Collaborative Labs". High level: a 60-minute customer-focused webinar (15min Redwood product demo, 20min partner case study, 20min joint panel + 5min CTAs), followed by a 30-min optional office hours the following week.

Questions from our side:
- Do you have capacity for a pilot in late August / early September? We have two windows: Aug 22 or Sep 12 (both Wednesdays).
- Can Redwood provide a 15-minute product demo slot and identify one or two customer references who could speak for ~8min each?
- Who will own the registration page, copy, and promotional cadence? DevCraft can take the social/paid promotion on our channels if Redwood runs the registration and email nurture.
- Any compliance/redline requirements for our co-marketing agreement? We can share a short proposal.

Attached: a short proposal & audience notes.

Appreciate a quick read — happy to hop on a 20-min sync if useful.

Best,
Lucia Gomez
Head of Partnerships, DevCraft
[Attachment: devcraft_proposal.docx (docx)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lucia Gomez <lucia@devcraft.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort Spotlight: Collaborative Labs pilot — logistics and assets

Thanks Lucia — thrilled to run this with DevCraft. Aug 22 works best for our product/marketing calendar; we can do 11:00am PT to hit both US coasts and record for EMEA replays.

Draft agenda (we can iterate):
- 00:00–00:05 — Welcome / goal framing (Mina)
- 00:05–00:20 — Redwood product demo (Ben)
- 00:20–00:40 — DevCraft case study + customer testimonial (DevCraft + customer)
- 00:40–00:55 — Joint panel / implementation tips (Mina + DevCraft PM + customer)
- 00:55–01:00 — Next steps / CTA (both)

Operational notes:
- Redwood will host the registration page (we use HubSpot) and handle reminder/follow-up emails.
- Ben will own creative assets & slides; Neha will coordinate amplification with demand gen.
- If DevCraft can share one customer who is willing to speak and a 1-page success blurb, we can lock the agenda.

Attached a very short draft agenda we can share with speakers. If you prefer Sep 12 instead, tell us now — otherwise we'll tentatively schedule Aug 22 11:00am PT and loop in our marketing ops.

Mina Haddad
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: cohort_spotlight_draft_agenda.pdf (pdf)]

- Assets: we'll need DevCraft logos (SVG/PNG) and a headshot + short bio for each speaker by 2028-07-28 to meet creative lead times.
- Co-marketing agreement: Does DevCraft prefer a simple one-page co-marketing addendum or a DocuSign MSA? If you have a template, drop it here.

I've attached our logo/specs for placement and colors. I'll put Neha on a separate thread with our demand gen calendar once dates are confirmed.

Ben Carter
